  "service_recommendation_line_items": [
    "For units operating in high ambient and/or humid/corrosive conditions: perform routine turbine wheel inspections at intervals based on installed configuration (shot peening condition at first fire, cooling slot geometry, material heat treatment, balance rail & lock wire tab configuration) per Tables 1–6.",
    "Stage 1 & Stage 2 wheel dovetail Eddy Current Inspection (ECI): perform at the frequency defined in the applicable configuration table (Tables 1–6) and continue until rotor retirement; ECI is available and recommended for all wheel posts identified in Tables 1 and 2.",
    "If cooling slot crack is detected during inspection: immediate wheel replacement will be recommended to help avoid the risk of wheel post liberation during operation.",
    "Visual inspection (VT) / borescope inspection (BI): for non-shot peened rotors, perform visual inspection of all exposed turbine rotor surfaces when available; observe/borescope accessible rotor surfaces and examine broach slot fillets/slot bottoms/tangs/cooling slots, cooling slots in wheel broach slots, spacer rim seal tooth rubs/coating, balance weights (looseness/migration/staking quality/set screw), nut damage/surface indications in flanges and webs.",
    "Ultrasonic testing (UT): inspect counterbore outside diameter ligaments on distance piece and turbine aft shaft.",
    "Fluorescent penetrant inspection (FPI): inspect staked balance weight grooves at all major inspection intervals and when the CDC is removed during a Hot Gas Path inspection; inspect lock wire tab fillets when turbine blades are removed during routine maintenance intervals; do not use FPI for wheel posts.",
    "Stage 3 turbine wheel (TW3) balance weight grooves: if staked, FPI every Major Inspection (MI) and when the Exhaust Frame is removed during Hot Gas Path Inspection (HGPI); if stakeless, no inspections necessary.",
    "Stage 3 turbine wheel (TW3) lockwire tabs: if original, FPI every HGPI while buckets are removed; if modified, FPI every MI.",
    "Turbine aft shaft (TAS) balance weight grooves: if staked, FPI every MI and when the Exhaust Frame is removed during HGPI; if stakeless, no inspections necessary.",
    "Install dovetail modified ('back cut') Stage 1 and Stage 2 turbine blades on all turbine rotors; apply at the next scheduled maintenance (HGPI or MI) and ensure inventory parts are modified during standard repair/refurbishment by a GE Vernova Service Center.",
    "Cleaning prerequisite for ECI: prior to ECI, appropriately clean turbine rotor (preferred dry ice/CO2 blasting; acceptable hand-cleaning if CO2 blast not available) to facilitate proper functioning of ECI equipment and accurate readings."
  ],
